props: Create a production pixel-art environment prop atlas for an original narrative science-fantasy RPG, the final region LAST CROWN. This is a strange, tender garden of ivory grown architecture and impossible human memories, not a desert, forest reskin, or spaceship corridor. Premium authored pixel clusters, crisp dark teal outlines, limited material colors, selective tiny gold highlights, rich organic forms, 3/4 overhead view, consistent upper-left light. Native detail equivalent to 128–180 pixel tall world props, enlarged nearest-neighbor; no antialiasing, painterly blur, text, people, logos. Output transparent RGBA with actual alpha, no checkerboard painted into pixels. EXACT 4 columns by 2 rows of square equal cells,2048×1024. Every complete isolated object centered in its own cell, generous 25px empty padding and no overlap. In reading order: 1) a crooked ivory-barked memory orchard tree, teal and lavender leaf fans, amber fruits, exposed coral-like roots, asymmetrical silhouette;2) a slender bone-white branching prayer antenna, suspended small amber memory beads, teal copper roots;3) a monumental open palm-shaped ivory garden engine with a hollow central oval and warm amber crystal, sculptural open negative space, stepped root base, no face;4) an elegant asymmetrical ivory rib arch with dark teal sockets and hanging small garden vines, clear open doorway;5) a low cluster of porous ivory garden stones with teal seams and tiny lavender flowers;6) a small humane refuge cottage grown from ivory curved ribs, dark teal curved roof, one visible warm amber open door centered on facade, little herb beds and irregular handcrafted repairs;7) an organically sprawling quiet teal/lavender moonflower and fern clump, a few amber buds;8) a broad sheer ivory cliff cross-section with curved architectural ribs embedded in it, dark teal recesses and hanging delicate roots. Palette luminous bone and muted lavender/teal, shadows indigo; warm amber is scarce. Different deliberate silhouettes, convincing pixel material, beautiful final-region sense of hope and uncanny scale. No props clipping any cell.
